description: AGSC-01-22 as amended for 1.1: every item an import writes from a source this node does not own is written with status draft, whatever its licence and whatever status the source gave it, and reported once as AGSC-E506. Derivation over one OKF document that declares an established licence, CC0-1.0, and the status stable: before 1.1 it kept status stable and drew no warning; now the mapped frontmatter carries status draft, keeps the licence, and there is exactly one AGSC-E506 warning, for the draft status, and no error.
